title: Army Museum in Białystok
geometryBasis: Native 17-vertex way 231111093 fixes the three-storey 7 Jana Kilińskiego street building. The former museum identity and matching address are pinned by mapped node 9341475660.
sectionBasis: Two exact CC0 exterior photos establish the three-storey elevations, projecting balconies, dark lettering and painted plaster. The commissioned building assessment records the monopitch roof. Roof rise, fine sections and door placement are proportional estimates.
limitations: The native outline and two exact 2020 views establish the street building and major window and balcony layout. Roof height, plaque, medallion and obscured rear ground level are simplified estimates.
The original elevation field is unchanged. The model represents the Kilińskiego premises while used as the museum in August 2020. The adjacent address, interiors and later site are outside scope.
